notes:
What's new in DuckOS 1.0.82

• Adding cards now happens in your DuckWallet, the one on your home screen. 1.0.80 and 1.0.81 sent DuckPay's "+" to a different, hidden wallet app by mistake; DuckPay's "+" and DuckWallet's own "+" now both open the new adding in DuckWallet.
• Everything from 1.0.80 and 1.0.81 is there: hold your card up to the camera (number across or stacked, expiry, name, the issuer and the card's own picture), Card Details with the check that it's a real card number, "Card Added" with the card's look, "Cards Found For You", and Create a Pass with barcode and QR code scanning. A pass or store card shows its barcode when you open it in DuckWallet.
